title: "MV_2025-10-26"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(ggVennDiagram)

MVaggregatedpath <- here("data","aggregated","MV_aggregated.csv")
aggregated <- read_csv(MVaggregatedpath)
```

```{r}

relative_proportions <- aggregated %>% group_by(Survey_Year,Substrate) %>%
  summarize(substrate_count = sum(Count)) %>% 
  mutate(total = sum(substrate_count)) %>% 
  mutate(proportion = substrate_count / total)

# test of concept
relative_proportions %>% filter(Substrate == "Habitat Feature - Hibernacula") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Survey_Year,y = proportion)) + 
  geom_line() + theme_light() +
  labs(title = "Hibernacula Substrate Relative Usage Over Time",x = "Survey Year",
       y = "Proportion (per Year)") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

# all substrates relative proportion of observations over time
relative_proportions %>% ggplot(aes(x = Survey_Year,y = proportion)) +
  geom_line() + theme_light() +
  facet_wrap(~ Substrate,scale = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Survey Year",y = "Proportion (per Year)",title = "Relative Usage over Time by Substrate") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
# substrates not generating graph:
# air/flyover
# rock
# telephone wire
# vernal pool

```

```{r}

# proof of concept venn diagram
hibernacula_only <- aggregated %>% filter(Substrate == "Habitat Feature - Hibernacula")
hibernacula_venn <- split(hibernacula_only$Count,hibernacula_only$Survey_Year)
HV1 <- hibernacula_venn[1:4]
HV2 <- hibernacula_venn[3:6]
HV3 <- hibernacula_venn[5:8]
ggVennDiagram(HV1)
# minimal overlap between species observed at hibernacula substrate over survey years 1 to 4
```
